title: Independent verification result
description: Output of stage 09_verification, produced by deterministic recomputation code (never by an LLM) and consumed by the verifier note, report and registry stages. Check statuses are lowercase (pass/fail/warn/skip), matching aicwf.verify.checks. A PASS verdict with a fail check is contradictory and is rejected by aicwf.agents.validate.validate_verification_dict. The schema is forward-compatible at the top level: new optional keys may be added by the verifier without breaking consumers.

as_of.description: Information cutoff of the verified run.

checks.description: One entry per independent check; ids match config/gates.yaml required_checks.

recomputed.description: Independently recomputed numbers (metrics, benchmark_metrics, weights, cash, ...). Numbers only: no wall-clock timestamps.

discrepancies.description: Every mismatch found between produced artifacts and the independent recomputation.

artifact_hashes.description: sha256 of every verified artifact, logical name -> hex digest.

snapshot.description: Snapshot identity of the verified run (hash, as_of, path).

verifier.description: Verifier identity metadata (role/name/model/version and check counters).
